cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 counts refugees or displaced people with a SIM, an account or a digital ID.
cells.note: Restaged under messages-for-bill 135 (a registered count is enough): 9,625 displaced Burkinabes were biometrically registered by February 2025 (GHA-008), and refugees may obtain the national ID card and must register SIMs with their refugee ID (GHA-007, GHA-009). No count of refugees with a SIM, account or ID, so not 5.
